#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    
    bool result = true;
    if (w >= 4) {
        int temp = m;
        while (temp > 0) {
            int remainder = temp % w;
            if (remainder > 1 && remainder != w - 1) {
                result = false;
                break;
            }
            temp = (temp + 1) / w;
        }
    } else {
        result = true;
    }
    
    cout << (result ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
